Container.Name: Web-Check

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port used to access the Web-Check web interface.

Config.Name: Shodan API Key
Config.Description: Optional Shodan API key used by Web-Check for additional hostname and IP enrichment.

Config.Name: Google Cloud API Key
Config.Description: Optional Google Cloud API key used for PageSpeed Insights and related checks.

Config.Name: WhoAPI API Key
Config.Description: Optional WhoAPI key used to retrieve additional domain information.

Config.Name: URLScan API Key
Config.Description: Optional URLScan API key used for additional URL intelligence.

Config.Name: API Rate Limit
Config.Description: Enable rate limiting on Web-Check API endpoints. Recommended when exposing Web-Check through a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: API Timeout
Config.Description: Maximum timeout for public API requests, in milliseconds.

Config.Name: API CORS Origin
Config.Description: Optional allowed origin(s) for API CORS.

Config.Name: Disabled Checks
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of Web-Check checks to disable.

Config.Name: Enabled Checks
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of checks to enable exclusively.

Config.Name: Blocked Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of hosts or networks that Web-Check must never scan.

Container.Overview:
Web-Check is an open-source OSINT tool for analysing websites and domains. It provides information about IP addresses, SSL certificates, DNS records, cookies, HTTP headers, domain information, crawl rules, redirects, open ports, traceroute, DNS security, performance, trackers, associated hostnames and other website intelligence.
Web-Check requires no configuration for basic use. Optional API keys can enable additional enrichment and external service integrations.

Container.Requires: No special privileges are required. Optional API keys can be configured to enable additional checks and enrichment features.
